messages:
Sam K: Heads up — during the staged rollout to eu-west we see a ~12% increase in p95 for short-sequence workloads compared to baseline. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/rollouts/1751 :eyes:
Jordan L: saw that too. Is it across all variants or just the quantized path?
Sam K: looks like quantized-x8 path only (small-seq <128). Rolling stats attached in the dashboard.
Alexa P: can someone run a quick per-core profile on one of the failing shards? I can review traces.
Tia R: I can spin a debug instance. Which node image + model?
Sam K: model: rwd-7b-v2-q8, node: gpu-p4-small-2025-03. Command to repro locally:
```
export RBW_ENV=staging
python infra/tools/run_bench.py --model rwd-7b-v2-q8 --seq 64 --batch 1 --profile perf --duration 60
```
Jordan L: scheduling that now on a spare pool. tagging @perf-bot to collect flamegraphs.
perf-bot: Started profiling job 1751239999-1 on gpu-p4-small-2025-03. Expected artifacts in s3://perf-artifacts/1751239999/ within ~8m.
Megan S: quick question — do we have an AB fallback to the non-quantized path if the staged SLO breaches?
Sam K: yes, rollout policy has auto-fallback to rwd-7b-v2-fp16 after 3 consecutive p95 violations in 10m. We are at 2/3 now.
Alexa P: if the profile pins it to kernel divergence, we should consider a temporary kernel pin + revert quantization for in-flight rollouts.
Jordan L: initial flamegraphs show a spike in cudnn matmul overhead at tail tokens. Uploading snapshot.
Sam K: thanks. tagging @Megan S for hold/rollback decision — do we want to pause the staged rollout while we bisect kernels?
Megan S: put a pause. I'm approving a temporary hold. Deploy-bot, pause rollout 1751. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rollout 1751 paused by Megan S at 175123, status -> PAUSED. Notifying oncall.
Tia R: I'll run a kernel-bisect build (cuda 12.2 vs 12.3) on the repro job and attach traces. ETA ~20m.
Jordan L: also trying a quick rerun with prefetched KV cache disabled to rule out memory-layout interaction.
Sam K: good call. if KV tweak fixes it, we can fast-fail the quant path and continue rollout.
perf-bot: Artifacts uploaded: s3://perf-artifacts/1751239999/1751239999-1/{flame.svg,profiles.pb}.
Alexa P: looking at flame.svg — hotspot in fused-attn-kernel on seq=64 tail, seems to regress with cuda12.3.
Megan S: decision: keep rollout paused, notify product + customers in the canary cohort, rollback not necessary yet. Engineers continue bisect and attempt kernel pin.
Sam K: noted. I'll file a short incident card with links and steps taken. Thanks all. :heart:
Jordan L: ping me if you want me to revert the quantization PR on the serving side, I can open it now.
Sam K: please wait for kernel bisect results first. If we confirm kernel regression we'll revert quant change and fast-track a patch.
Megan S: adding follow-up: create a short perf regression postmortem if rollback happens.
Sam K: agreed. closing thread for now — will update when bisect finishes.
